scope: Source inventory, deterministic local-fixture verification, dashboard/API boundary checks, and truthful-claim review for the public Kiroween 2026 source revision.
executionBoundary: All verified workflows use local in-memory fixtures. The audit did not connect to AWS, query CloudWatch or Cost Explorer, deploy a Lambda, execute Kiro Crew/CLI/Web, run a Kiro hook or power, or terminate an AWS resource.
verificationCommands: POST /api/kiro-crew/execute with explicit local fixture resourceId

automatedTestResult.note: Node TAP counts the outer suite in addition to its 16 nested checks. The standalone gate is run after the TAP suite by npm run ci.

manualLocalSmokeResult.statusEndpoint: GET /api/status returned local-demo-fixtures-no-aws-account, five active fixtures, risk index 88, and explicit target i-0f948a913bc89a712.
manualLocalSmokeResult.workflowEndpoint: POST /api/kiro-crew/execute with the explicit EC2 fixture returned local-demo-fixture, a 100/100 local gate, a 64-character receipt digest, four remaining active fixtures, and risk index 65.
manualLocalSmokeResult.validationEndpoint: POST /api/exorcise with an empty JSON object returned HTTP 400 RESOURCE_ID_REQUIRED.
manualLocalSmokeResult.dashboard: GET / served the explicit LOCAL DEMO FIXTURES — NO AWS ACCOUNT CONNECTED boundary.

claimReview.dashboard: The dashboard fetches same-origin API state and returned receipts; it does not use timer-only simulated success.
claimReview.kiroAssets: Root .kiro assets exist and label themselves illustrative/unverified. Their presence is not runtime execution evidence.
claimReview.receipt: Receipt digest is a SHA-256 integrity check over canonical local-fixture receipt data; it is unsigned and is not proof of a cloud action.
claimReview.license: README, package.json, and LICENSE identify MIT.
